caseData.headline: Likely: bad loans are being reported as good ones

findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones
the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender
the reported financial statements don't fit the evidence
the borrower has debt it has not disclosed

signals.explanation: Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 3 of 3 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
4 loans' credit scores at origination were rewritten after the fact, from below the 600 eligibility line to above it
Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
'Prairie Capital Partners LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Crescent Credit LP': all receivables and chattel paper (loan collateral)) that the borrower never disclosed
Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings
Reported revenue is running 19% above what verified customer cash supports (2 quarters in a row)
'Redwood Specialty Finance LP' holds a lien on the borrower ('Crescent Credit LP': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed (filed before onboarding: may be a stale filing)
Covenant metric landed within 5% above the threshold two quarters running
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified

steps.title: Pause new advances against the affected collateral
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Pause new advances against the affected collateral
Case: B0042 · Finding: the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender (medium confidence)
Action: Place a hold on further advances against the collateral named in the evidence until uniqueness is confirmed.
Based on:
  - 'Prairie Capital Partners LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Crescent Credit LP': all receivables and chattel paper (loan collateral)) that the borrower never disclosed [ref S5-B0042-COMPETING_LIEN-2511f217]
  - Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings [ref S7-B0042-DEBT_GAP-2d313b02]

Due: 2026-09-12 · Requires approval before it is carried out.

steps.title: Ask the other secured party for a payoff / estoppel letter

DRAFT LETTER — Ask the other secured party for a payoff / estoppel letter
To: Prairie Capital Partners LLC (secured party of record)
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0042)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:

  - Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings [ref S7-B0042-DEBT_GAP-2d313b02]

Please provide a payoff or estoppel letter stating the collateral you claim, the amount outstanding, and whether any of it overlaps the listed assets by 2026-09-16.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
